questions: Does the controller keep line losses at zero on the unseen track shape, and where does the first drift to the 0.06 m edge occur?
If the controller has room to change without touching geometry, which gain change would reduce the edge drift on the tightest bend?
feedback_request.requested_changes_if_any: Keep the geometry at 0.6 kg. Do not move mass below 0.6 kg or retry the inner ±0.04 m spacing, the 16 mm footprint, the 0.10 m track or y 0.06 m, since each was rejected by measured evidence.

intent: Ship the iteration 8 and 10 geometry unchanged (0.6 kg, outer ±0.06 m, inner ±0.03 m, y 0.04 m, 12 mm footprints, 0.12 m track, 0.03 m radius). This is a reproduced, zero-loss design with the best measured score, chosen for the unseen-track final race, where a known result beats an unmeasured mass step near the 0.5 kg cliff.
learning: Mass 0.6 kg with the iteration 5 sensor layout is the measured optimum: 0.8 kg gave 151.9, 0.6 kg gave 257.45 (reproduced), and 0.5 kg gave 81.2. The 0.55 kg step remains untested and was not shipped because it is the final iteration.
rationale: The final iteration should ship the most reliable measured design, not an untested improvement. Iteration 8 (0.6 kg, iteration 5 layout) scored 257.45, and iteration 10 reproduced it exactly (same score and per-track metrics), so the result is stable across runs. Its oval progress is 0.89 with 10 of 20 finishes, line losses are zero on every track, and max_error is 0.0603 m on s-bend and 0.0615 m on slalom. Iteration 9 showed that 0.5 kg collapses oval progress to 0.27 with no finishes, so the mass cliff lies below 0.6 kg. The Integrator's optional 0.55 kg step is permitted by its own rule, since the reproduction condition is now met. I decline it because this is the final iteration: a 0.55 kg result would never be observed, so it gives no learning, and the unseen-track final race is scored on whatever design ships. An untested mass step below the measured cliff risks the same collapse, so I keep the best measured geometry. Sensor layout (outer ±0.06 m, inner ±0.03 m, y 0.04 m), 12 mm footprints, 0.12 m track, 0.03 m radius and the body are all unchanged. Expected result: the iteration 8 outcome, about 257 on the development tracks, with the unseen track scored as the design performs there.
